### 1. **WHAT THE APP DOES**

Pinzo is a Shopify embedded admin app that lets merchants control delivery availability by ZIP code. Key capabilities:

- **ZIP Code Management** — Add/edit/activate/deactivate allowed and blocked ZIP codes
- **Delivery Zones & ETAs** — Group ZIP codes into zones with estimated delivery times
- **Delivery Rules** — Zone-based rules for fees, minimum order amounts, cutoff times, day-of-week schedules
- **Customer Waitlist** — Capture emails from unsupported areas; bulk notify when coverage expands
- **Widget Customization** — Style the storefront ZIP code checker widget (colors, text, layout, custom CSS)
- **Billing** — Multi-tier SaaS: Free / Starter / Pro / Ultimate with monthly/annual options
- **Feature Requests** — Community voting system for feature ideas (all plans)
- **GDPR Compliance** — Mandatory webhooks: `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`

---

**Core Stack:**
- **Framework:** React Router 7 (`@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1) — NOT Remix
- **UI Library:** Shopify Polaris v13 (`@shopify/polaris`)
- **App Bridge:** `@shopify/app-bridge-react` v4
- **Database:** Prisma v6 with PostgreSQL (production) / SQLite (dev)
- **Language:** TypeScript (strict mode, zero `.js` files)
- **Bundler:** Vite v6
- **Node:** ≥20.19

**API & Auth:**
- Shopify Admin API (January 2026 = `2026-01`)
- OAuth via `shopify.server.ts` → `authenticate.admin(request)`
- Session storage: Prisma session storage
- Public APIs for storefront widget (no auth required)

**Infrastructure & Deployment:**
- **Hosting:** Railway (production) at `https://zip-code-checker-production-b1a0.up.railway.app`
- **Email:** Resend (transactional emails)

## Comprehensive Pinzo Shopify App Exploration

I've completed a thorough exploration of the Pinzo project. Here's the full breakdown:

---

### 1. **WHAT THE APP DOES**

Pinzo is a Shopify embedded admin app that lets merchants control delivery availability by ZIP code. Key capabilities:

- **ZIP Code Management** — Add/edit/activate/deactivate allowed and blocked ZIP codes
- **Delivery Zones & ETAs** — Group ZIP codes into zones with estimated delivery times
- **Delivery Rules** — Zone-based rules for fees, minimum order amounts, cutoff times, day-of-week schedules
- **Customer Waitlist** — Capture emails from unsupported areas; bulk notify when coverage expands
- **Widget Customization** — Style the storefront ZIP code checker widget (colors, text, layout, custom CSS)
- **Billing** — Multi-tier SaaS: Free / Starter / Pro / Ultimate with monthly/annual options
- **Feature Requests** — Community voting system for feature ideas (all plans)
- **GDPR Compliance** — Mandatory webhooks: `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`

---

### 2. **TECH STACK & ARCHITECTURE**

**Core Stack:**
- **Framework:** React Router 7 (`@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1) — NOT Remix
- **UI Library:** Shopify Polaris v13 (`@shopify/polaris`)
- **App Bridge:** `@shopify/app-bridge-react` v4
- **Database:** Prisma v6 with PostgreSQL (production) / SQLite (dev)
- **Language:** TypeScript (strict mode, zero `.js` files)
- **Bundler:** Vite v6
- **Node:** ≥20.19

**API & Auth:**
- Shopify Admin API (January 2026 = `2026-01`)
- OAuth via `shopify.server.ts` → `authenticate.admin(request)`
- Session storage: Prisma session storage
- Public APIs for storefront widget (no auth required)

**Infrastructure & Deployment:**
- **Hosting:** Railway (production) at `https://zip-code-checker-production-b1a0.up.railway.app`
- **Email:** Resend (transactional emails)
- **Customer Support:** Chatwoot live chat widget
- **Webhooks:** Shopify app subscriptions, GDPR, OAuth scopes

```
app/
  shopify.server.ts    — Shopify auth setup + billing config
  db.server.ts         — Prisma client singleton
  billing.server.ts    — Subscription logic + plan helpers
  plans.ts             — Pricing tiers + feature flags (PLAN_LIMITS)

    app._index.tsx     — Dashboard

    api.*.tsx          — Public API endpoints

    auth.*             — OAuth flow
  utils/
    agent.server.ts    — Claude Hub agent client
    zip.ts             — ZIP code utilities

prisma/
  schema.prisma        — Database schema
  migrations/          — Migration history

extensions/

    shopify.extension.toml
    blocks:
      - zip-code-checker
      - cart-validator
      - app_embed

shopify.app.toml       — Shopify app config
```

**Admin Dashboard (app._index.tsx — 521 lines)**
- Usage stats: total ZIP codes, allowed/blocked counts, delivery rules, waitlist entries
- Theme embed detection (checks if app embed is enabled in active theme)
- Quick action buttons to navigate features
- Trial status & upgrade prompts
- Theme editor links with automatic numeric ID parsing

**ZIP Code Management (app.zip-codes.tsx — 2093 lines)**
- Full CRUD for ZIP codes
- Type toggle: "allowed" vs "blocked"
- Zone assignment & ETA labels
- CSV import (Starter+)
- Bulk operations
- Multi-column sortable table
- Plan-based limits (Free: 20 ZIPs, Starter: 500, Pro/Ultimate: unlimited)

**Delivery Rules (app.delivery-rules.tsx — 793 lines)**
- Create delivery zones with:
  - Min order amounts
  - Delivery fees
  - Free shipping thresholds
  - Estimated delivery days
  - Cutoff times (e.g., "14:00")
  - Day-of-week schedules (e.g., "Mon,Tue,Wed")
  - Priority ordering
- Max 3 rules (Starter), unlimited (Pro/Ultimate)

**Waitlist Management (app.waitlist.tsx — 1456 lines)**
- View captured ZIP code requests from customers
- Bulk notify action (sends emails via Resend)
- Filter by status: waiting, notified, converted, etc.
- Pagination
- Email integration with custom sender names

**Widget Customization (app.widget.tsx — 1899 lines)**
- Full theme builder for storefront widget:
  - Colors: primary, success, error, background, text
  - Text: heading, placeholder, button text, messages
  - Layout: inline, floating, popup
  - Features toggle: show ETA, zone, waitlist, COD, return policy, delivery fee, cutoff time, countdown, social proof

  - Border radius & custom CSS (Ultimate plan only)

  - Pro: $9.99/mo or $79/yr
  - Ultimate: $19.99/mo or $149/yr

  - CORS enabled for storefront requests

- `app/scopes_update` — Handle scope changes
- `app_subscriptions/update` — Sync billing from Shopify
- `customers/data_request` — GDPR data export request
- `customers/redact` — Delete customer PII (waitlist)
- `shop/redact` — Delete all shop data 48h after uninstall

**Theme App Extension (zip-code-widget):**
- Shopify Liquid theme extension with 3 block types:
  1. `zip-code-checker` — Main widget
  2. `cart-validator` — Cart validation block
  3. `app_embed` — Full-page embed (body target)
